_about: Halls of the Diamond King overlay. Items and hazards follow the dungeon's own notes (data); wording marked new.

note:3-1.description: A silver chess piece, a king, heavier than it looks.

note:4.description: A tall mirror in a tarnished frame. You keep your eyes on the frame.

hazard.text: You look into the glass. The cold climbs from your feet to your heart, and you become a statue of yourself.

note:5.description: A small relic of crystal and gold, faintly warm.

note:1.here: A handsome druid rests on the ground, eyes half closed.
note:1.talk: The druid opens one eye. "Lost, or looking? Ask me about the place, if you like."

topics.mirror|glass: Whatever you do in the mirror room, don't look into the glass. I've seen what it leaves behind.
topics.wyrm|dragon|beast: It sleeps where the king once held court, deep in, past the scorched gate. Don't wake it; don't even knock.
topics.key|gate: There's a key at the bottom of a pool somewhere in the north halls. The water is colder than it looks.
topics.king|diamond: A king of diamonds and dust. The fresco by the south passage shows him; the throne is all that's left.

bread|rations|food.text: The druid eats slowly. "Kindness, down here. Listen: count the doors you pass. The one that isn't drawn on any wall is the one you want."
